verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Warp natively supports multiple panes, tabs, and windows within a single session (e.g., running agent conversations 'in different windows, tabs, or panes' and restoring 'windows, tabs, panes' on relaunch), indicating built-in multiplexing without needing tmux/screen. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of pane-splitting UI/keyboard shortcuts, and independent/community confirmation that pane management specifically works well in practice.
